name: Akanegasaki Sora
source:
The only full-time staff member of LeMU to be stranded, Sora is a professional computer engineer, [spoiler]as well as the main AI. Although she is an AI, she can think on her own, as[/spoiler] she tries her best to get everyone stranded on LeMU to safety.

She thinks rationally at all times, not allowing emotions to sway her decisions. [spoiler]She is programmed to act 24 years old.[/spoiler] She likes flowers, animals, and anything living in nature.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ever_17]Wikipedia[/url]]

[spoiler]Her official designation is LM-RSDS-4913A in the original, and LM-QS16 in the remake.[/spoiler]
